units.source_text: 日后回想起来，乍看似突然出走，其实则是经过长期深思熟虑和犹豫的。

en.t: Looking back on it later, what at first seemed like a sudden flight was in fact something that had passed through a long period of careful thought and hesitation.

units.source_text: 然而，我总喜欢把它认为是被突然的冲动所驱使的行为。

en.t: And yet I always preferred to regard it as an act driven by a sudden impulse.

units.source_text: 因为我内心缺乏根本性的冲动，所以我尤其喜欢模仿冲动。

en.t: Because my heart lacked any fundamental impulse, I was especially fond of imitating impulse.

units.source_text: 譬如，有的男人头天晚上计划好第二天去祭扫父亲的墓，可是第二天出了家门，来到车站前的时候，突然改变了主意，转而到酒友家中去了，这种情况能说他是纯粹的冲动吗？

en.t: For example, suppose a man plans the night before to visit his father's grave the next day, but the next day, after leaving home and reaching the front of the station, he suddenly changes his mind and goes instead to the house of a drinking companion. Can such a case be called pure impulse?

units.source_text: 他的突然改变主意，难道不是比迄今长期准备去扫墓更有意识的、对自己的意志的一种报复行为吗？

en.t: Was his sudden change of mind not a more conscious act than the long preparation he had made up to then to visit the grave, a kind of revenge against his own will?
